concept.title: HP SmartTracker
concept.shortdesc: HP SmartTracker has been designed to help you control your printing costs and accurately charge your customers for the prints you do for them.

note.p: HP SmartTracker software is compatible only with Original HP ink supplies.

section.title: Scheduled Reports
section.p: The Scheduled Reports feature allows administrators to configure automatic email delivery of usage reports.

section.title: Accessing the Scheduling Interface
section.p: To access the scheduling interface, navigate to the Reports section in the HP SmartTracker dashboard and select 'Scheduled Reports'.

section.title: Setting Up Email Recipients
section.p: Administrators can set up email recipients for user, project, or department reports by entering the email addresses in the designated fields within the scheduling interface.

section.title: Choosing Report Frequency
section.p: Reports can be scheduled to be sent on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis. Select the desired frequency from the options provided in the scheduling interface.

section.title: Configuring the Email Server
section.p: To configure the email server for sending reports, follow these steps:

ol.li: Navigate to the Email Server Settings in the HP SmartTracker dashboard.
Enter the SMTP server address and port number.
Provide the necessary authentication details, such as username and password.
Test the configuration to ensure emails can be sent successfully.

section.title: Setting a Custom Company Logo
section.p: To set a custom company logo for branded reports, upload the logo image in the 'Company Logo' section of the scheduling interface.
